name: Grant Drives Through Distress
description: Grant drives his luxury pickup truck down the road, sweat glistening on his skin as his eyes blink rapidly. His hands remain on the wheel, the vehicle moving forward despite his visible discomfort.
related_events: Grant drives his luxury pickup truck down the road while showing signs of distress

name: Rancher Sees Meteor Heading Toward Forest
description: The rancher, his head turned, watches the meteor grow larger as it hurtles toward the treetops of a nearby forest.
related_events: Rancher observes meteor approaching forest

name: Starla Puts on Earrings
description: Starla stands in front of the mirror above her dresser, adjusting a pair of earrings. She is dressed in her weekend finery, the fabric catching the light as she lifts each earring into place. The room is quiet except for the soft clink of metal against her fingertips.
related_events: Starla puts on earrings in front of dresser mirror

name: Grant Finds His Way Through the Woods
description: Grant moves up a hill through a stretch of trees, glancing around as he walks. He stops briefly, standing still while looking in different directions. After a moment, he turns and continues walking, following a path through the forest.
related_events: Grant searches for direction while moving through a wooded area

name: Grant Answers Hank Wilcox's Call
description: Grant returns home to a dark, quiet house with only one light on. As he steps inside, the phone rings. He picks it up and hears Hank Wilcox on the other end of the line.
related_events: Grant receives phone call from Hank Wilcox upon returning home

name: Grant Finds the Barn and Gathers Foliage
description: Grant comes upon an old wooden barn, its weathered walls covered in graffiti. The structure stands silent, long abandoned. Moments later, he begins gathering large fronds and other foliage, arms filling with greenery.
related_events: Grant discovers abandoned wooden barn covered in graffiti
Grant collects large fronds and foliage

name: Grant Treats His Infected Wound
description: Grant holds up his shirt and looks at the wound on his side. The skin around it is blackened and swollen, with a puffy, veiny spout rising from the center. Fuzzy bluish moss clings to the crevices surrounding the wound, and pus oozes out. He squeezes Neosporin onto his fingers and rubs it slowly into the area.
related_events: Grant examines his gangrenous wound
Grant applies Neosporin to the infected wound

name: Grant Builds a Nest in the Barn
description: Grant spreads plant life across the floor of the barn, arranging and fluffing it with his hands. He moves in a crouched, deliberate way, pausing to adjust clumps and layer the material. When finished, he sits back on his heels, looking at the arrangement. His face relaxes, and he remains still, watching the nest.
related_events: Grant arranges plant life to form a nest-like structure in the barn
Grant sits back to observe and expresses satisfaction with the nest

name: Cops React to Tremor and Enter Station
description: Four officers—Bill Pardy, Wally, Trevor, and Margaret—stand together in the police station parking lot. A sudden tremor ripples through the ground. They laugh quietly, exchanging brief reactions. Without delay, they walk into the station.
related_events: Cops feel unexplained tremor and react with laughter
Cops enter police station after tremor

name: Starla Stops at Sign and Sees Missing Pet Flyers
description: Starla drives with groceries in her car and comes to a stop at a stop sign. As the car halts, she looks toward the telephone pole beside the sign and sees it is covered with flyers for missing pets.
related_events: Starla stops her car at a stop sign
Starla observes missing pet flyers on a telephone pole

name: Grant Walks Toward the Playground
description: Grant steps out of the building and looks around. Across the parking lot, a playground comes into view. Two young children are spinning on a small carousel. Grant starts walking toward them.
related_events: Grant steps outside and observes the surroundings
Grant begins walking toward the children in the playground
Two young children spin on a carousel in the playground

name: Grant Loads Meat into Pickup
description: Grant backs his pickup truck toward the garage. He loads meat into the bed of the truck. Wrapped packages of meat are placed in the passenger seats around him.
related_events: Grant backs pickup truck toward garage
Meat is loaded into pickup truck bed
Wrapped meat packages fill passenger seats of pickup

name: Starla Finds Garage Door Locked
description: Starla pulls into her driveway and presses the button on her garage door opener. The door shudders but does not open. She gets out of the car and walks over to inspect it. At the base of the door, she sees a padlock has been attached, fastened to the cement driveway with bolts on both sides.
related_events: Starla arrives at her driveway and attempts to open the garage door
Starla discovers a padlock securing the garage door

name: Starla Returns to a Dark House
description: Starla walks into the house carrying a shopping bag. The house is dark, and she reaches for the light switch, but the lights do not come on. She mutters a quiet curse about the fuse. As she moves through the hallway, she passes the garage door and notices the lock in place.
related_events: Starla enters the building with a shopping bag
Power failure leaves the building in darkness
Starla attempts to turn on the lights with no success

name: Starla Responds to the Song
description: Starla stands in the bathroom, a white towel wrapped around her, brushing her wet hair in front of the foggy mirror. The opening notes of Air Supply's 'Every Woman in the World' drift in from the bedroom. She stops brushing, listens for a moment, then walks toward the bathroom door. She opens it and steps through.
related_events: Starla hears Air Supply's song from the bedroom
Starla moves toward the bathroom door
Starla opens the bathroom door

name: Starla Arrives and Hears a Moan from Upstairs
description: Starla sets down the grocery bags on the counter and looks around. No one answers, though she expected someone to be there. Her eyes land on a potted flower, where a green inchworm crawls slowly up the stem. She watches it for a moment. Then, a moan drifts down from upstairs.
related_events: Starla places grocery bags on the counter and notices absence of others
Starla observes inchworm climbing stem of potted flower
Starla hears moan originating from upstairs

name: Man Seeks Help for Missing Wife Brenda at Precinct
description: The front door of the precinct opens, and a Mexican man walks in, visibly distressed and struggling to hold back tears. Three half-naked children follow closely behind him, clinging to his clothes. He moves slowly through the office, glancing around uncertainly. Margaret notices him from her desk and stands slightly. Margaret: Sir, may I help -- ? The man turns to her, urgency in his voice: My wife, Brenda. I think something has happened to her!
related_events: Mexican man enters precinct with three children seeking help
Margaret offers assistance to distressed man
Man expresses concern about his wife Brenda's wellbeing

name: Grant Answers the Call While Sick
description: Grant stands at the sink, pale and sweating, one hand gripping the counter as he leans forward. He calls out, 'Yeah, hon, I'll be right there!' Then he turns, pushes open his door, and steps out.
related_events: Grant leans over sink while showing signs of illness
Grant responds to someone while unwell
Grant pushes open his door

name: Grant Returns Home and Talks to Neighbor
description: Grant steps out of his truck in the driveway. A neighbor, walking a beagle, calls out to him. The neighbor asks if Grant was night-fishing again and whether he caught anything. Grant replies that he caught a little something, then walks into his house.
related_events: Grant exits truck in driveway and greets neighbor
Neighbor inquires about night fishing during morning walk
Grant responds ambiguously to neighbor's fishing question
Grant enters his house after conversation with neighbor

name: Starla Meets the Boy Searching for Roscoe
description: Starla walked outside in her robe and saw a boy, about thirteen years old, stapling a LOST: REWARD flyer to a telephone pole. The flyer had a picture of a beagle. She looked at the flyer and said, "Roscoe's gone?" The boy turned to her, his face streaked with dried tears. "You haven't seen him, have you?" he asked. Starla shook her head. "I'm sure he'll show up, Tim," she said. The boy nodded, then walked down the street to the next telephone pole and began putting up another flyer.
related_events: Boy staples LOST: REWARD flyer to telephone pole
Starla asks about Roscoe's disappearance
Boy inquires if Starla has seen Roscoe
Starla reassures the boy about Roscoe
Boy walks to next pole to post another flyer

name: Cops Enter Diner Amid Kitchen Chaos
description: Four police officers enter the diner, causing a stir. Patrons stand up, murmuring and shifting uneasily. The Waitress turns toward the service window and calls out, 'Back there, Bill!' In the kitchen, a large man named Doe darts around erratically. The Dishwasher scrambles onto the counter and stands there, yelping in fear.
related_events: Cops enter the establishment causing commotion
Waitress alerts Bill about activity in the kitchen
Large Doe moves erratically in the kitchen
Dishwasher stands on counter expressing fear

name: Kylie and Her Friend See a Falling Meteor
description: As students leave for the day, Kylie and her friend step outside and look up at the sky. A meteor streaks across above them, drawing their attention. They watch it fall in silence for a moment. Then Kylie says they should go find it later and sell it on eBay.
related_events: Kylie and her friend observe the falling meteor
Kylie suggests finding and selling the meteor on eBay

name: Students Leave School as Meteor Appears
description: The school day ended, and students streamed out through the open door. Kylie, one of Starla's students, walked with her friend, both of them looking up at the sky as a meteor fell.
related_events: Students leave school for the day

name: Starla Shares a Moment of Marital Hope with Janene
description: Starla hums a tune while dropping coins into a soda machine and selects a can of Tab. Janene, a heavyset Black teacher, watches her and asks why she’s so smiley. Starla says it’s nothing, takes her soda, and sits down beside Janene. Janene keeps staring. Starla mentions she had a nice morning with Grant, adding that it’s been a while. Janene grins and teases her, saying she has that fresh-fucked glow. Starla says her name in mild reprimand. Janene calls her a slut. Starla tells her to hush. Janene says she has no shame, reminding her she’s a married woman. Starla replies that Grant was considerate, and maybe this is the start of a real change in him.
related_events: Starla hums a song while buying a soda
Janene questions Starla's cheerful demeanor
Janene teases Starla about having sex with Grant
Starla reveals she had a nice morning with Grant
Starla defends Grant's considerate behavior

name: Grant Reacts to Tremor After Meteor Impact
description: A framed wedding photograph on Grant's desk trembles as a result of a meteor impact. Grant looks up, noticing the movement, and turns his attention to the glass workshop outside his office. Two workers are carrying a large pane of glass, their steps unsteady for a moment but they manage to keep their footing. Grant calls out to them, saying it was just a tremor. The workers nod, visibly relieved. He then returns to his desk, picks up a Sharpie, and continues writing labels on file folders.
related_events: Meteor impact causes tremor in glass workshop
Grant notices photograph trembling on desk
Workers carry large pane of glass through workshop
Grant reassures workers after tremor
Grant resumes filling out file folder tags

name: Grant Leaves the Office for the Day
description: Grant locks his office and walks across the workshop toward the exit. His secretary, Ashley, calls out, 'Night, Mr. Grant.' He replies, 'See ya', Ashley,' and continues walking. A group of workers lingers around a glass-cutting table, laughing at something. Some of them nod in Grant's direction, and he nods back as he passes by.
related_events: Grant locks his office and departs for the day
Secretary greets Grant upon his departure

name: Grant Walks Past Laughing Workers in Workshop
description: Grant walks across the workshop toward the door. A group of workers is gathered around a glass-cutting table, laughing and lounging. As he passes, some of the workers nod in his direction, and he nods back. He continues on without stopping.
related_events: Workers laugh together while lounging at the glass-cutting table
Grant exchanges nods with workers at the glass-cutting table

name: Starla's Slow Goodnight
description: Starla stands in front of the mirror, brushing her hair with long, slow strokes. From the bedroom, Grant calls out, 'Sugarplum, you coming into bed?' Starla turns toward the door, pauses without speaking, then sets her brush down on the counter and arranges it neatly beside the other items. She walks into the bedroom.
related_events: Starla brushes her hair with long, slow strokes
Grant calls out to Starla from the bedroom
Starla responds to Grant's call
Starla walks into the bedroom

name: Starla Answers Grant's Call
description: Grant calls out from the bedroom, asking Starla to come to bed. Starla stands in front of the mirror, brushing her hair with long, slow strokes. She sets the brush down on the counter and arranges it neatly beside the others. Without speaking, she turns toward the door and walks into the bedroom.
related_events: Starla responds to Grant's call
Grant calls out to Starla from the bedroom

name: Grant Examines Himself in the Mirror Before Watching Starla
description: Grant creeps into the bedroom and looks around. He sees his face in the mirror above the dresser and moves closer, staring at his reflection. He pulls on his skin slightly, his eyes bright with excitement, and smiles at himself. The shower is still running. He turns toward the open bathroom door and creeps closer, then peers around the doorway. Starla stands in the shower, soaping her body. Grant watches her, motionless, his head tilted slightly to the side.
related_events: Grant creeps into the bedroom and observes his reflection

name: Grant Watches Starla in the Shower
description: Grant moves quietly toward the open bathroom door, the sound of running water filling the room. He pauses at the doorway and peers around the edge, his eyes fixed on Starla inside the shower. She stands under the stream, lathering her body with soap. He remains in the doorway, motionless, watching her.
related_events: Grant peers into the bathroom and watches Starla in the shower

name: Grant on the Porch at Dusk
description: Grant steps onto the front porch, blinking and unsteady, taking in the cool air. He looks down the street as a boy in a little league uniform and his mother get out of their car and walk toward their house. Across the street, through a kitchen window, a plump man and his wife sit at a table eating dinner. At a nearby home, a short man climbs a stepladder to change a dome light on the porch. Grant watches each of them, his gaze fixed and intense. A beagle next door barks, tugging at its leash tied to a tree. Grant turns toward the sound, then scans the street to make sure no one is looking.
related_events: Grant steps onto the front porch to get air
Short man changes porch dome light
Plump man and wife eat dinner inside their home
Boy and mother arrive home from little league game
Grant fights urge to lunge at nearby individuals

name: Grant Reacts to the Barking Beagle and Looks for Witnesses
description: Grant turns toward the neighbor's beagle, which is barking at him from where it is tied to a tree. He glances around the yard and down the street, checking to see if anyone is watching.
related_events: Beagle barks at Grant from tree
Grant checks if anyone is watching

name: Grant Takes Ingredients from the Refrigerator
description: Grant opens the refrigerator door and reaches inside. He takes out a loaf of bread and a package of cheese. He opens the meat drawer, which is full of cold cuts, and removes every type: Oscar Mayer baloney, turkey, pastrami, and salami. He sets them all on the counter.
related_events: Grant retrieves bread, cheese, and cold cuts from the refrigerator

name: Grant Builds and Alters a Sandwich
description: Grant sits at the table and begins assembling a sandwich with bread, cheese, and layers of cold cuts—baloney, turkey, pastrami, and salami—piling on more and more meat until the sandwich becomes a tall stack. He pauses, then takes off the cheese. He removes the bread as well. He looks at the remaining stack of meat, now standing in a tall pile without bread or cheese. After a moment, he stands and carries the pile away.
related_events: Grant assembles an overloaded sandwich at the table
Grant removes cheese and bread from the sandwich tower

name: Grant Contemplates and Carries Away the Meat Tower
description: Grant stands at the table, looking at the tall stack of cold cuts he has assembled. He removes the cheese, then the bread, leaving only the layered meats standing together. He pauses, studying the pile. Then he picks it up and walks away, carrying it with him.
related_events: Grant contemplates the tower of cold cuts
Grant carries off the pile of meat

name: Starla Notices the New Lock and Confronts Grant
description: Starla enters the house and walks toward the garage door, noticing a shiny new lock. She touches it, puzzled, and sees Grant standing at the end of the foyer, partially hidden in shadow. He steps forward, greeting her. She asks why there are locks on the garage and why the driveway has been drilled. Grant says he’s sorry and explains he got her a special birthday present and didn’t want her to find it. He calls her his princess and says he was excited to keep it a surprise. Starla gives a hesitant smile, says she needs to clean up before dinner, and starts up the stairs. Grant watches her from behind, his expression shifting as he murmurs, 'You're meat.' Starla turns, asking what he said. Grant shakes his head, smiles, and says it was nothing. She continues upstairs, uneasy.
related_events: Starla returns home and notices new garage lock
Grant greets Starla upon her arrival
Starla expresses confusion about the locked garage and driveway drilling
Grant reveals he installed locks to hide Starla's birthday present

name: Starla Retreats Upstairs After Grant's Disturbing Remark
description: After Grant stares at her with an intense and unsettling gaze, muttering 'You're meat,' Starla turns and asks what he said. Grant snaps out of it, brushes off the comment, and tells her it was nothing. Starla forces an uneasy smile, says she needs to clean up before dinner, and begins walking up the stairs. Grant watches her in silence as she leaves.
related_events: Starla decides to clean up before dinner
Grant leers at Starla and experiences a dark realization
Grant dismisses his comment and pretends nothing happened
Starla reacts uneasily and ascends the stairs

name: Grant Reacts to Hank's Phone Call During Dinner
description: Starla and Grant eat dinner in a well-decorated room. Grant answers a phone call meant for Starla and reacts with irritation, questioning why Hank is calling her at night. He repeats his disbelief to Starla, saying he told Hank it was inappropriate for a single man to call another man's wife. Starla responds quietly, explaining that Hank is teaching environmental science and likely wants to borrow her lesson plans from last semester. Grant scoffs, stuffing his mouth with food, and says Hank only wants to sleep with her, like most other men around. He tells Starla she’s too trusting and lucky to have him to protect her. Starla nods silently as Grant continues eating.
related_events: Grant expresses suspicion about a phone call from Hank
Starla downplays Hank's phone call as work-related
Grant insults Hank and expresses possessiveness over Starla

name: Dinner with Grant
description: Starla and Grant eat dinner in a well-decorated room. Grant speaks harshly, his mouth full of food, and mocks a phone call from a man named Hank. He questions the man’s intentions, suggesting he wants to sleep with Starla. Starla remains quiet, offering only a polite smile now and then. She says the call was about work, that the man is teaching environmental science and may want her old lesson plans. Grant dismisses her explanation, calling it nonsense, and insists the man only wants to sleep with her. He chews loudly, swallows, and tells her she’s lucky to have him, that she’s too trusting and would get herself killed without him. Starla says nothing, and at last, she nods silently.
related_events: Starla and Grant have dinner together in a well-decorated room
Grant eats food aggressively during dinner conversation
Starla passively responds to Grant's outburst with a nod

name: Grant Approaches Starla and the Tubule Emerges
description: Grant sees Starla sitting on the edge of the bed, her back to him, as she puts on her nylons. He moves slowly toward her, watching her. Something begins to push up from under his shirt at his stomach—a writhing, pointed tubule that slips out and extends toward Starla's back. Grant looks at the nape of her neck, at her ear. He softens. Starla turns and sees him, now turned away, struggling to push the tubule back under his shirt. 'What are you doing?' she asks. 'You're pretty,' he says. She nods, confused.
related_events: Grant stalks Starla while she puts on her nylons
Alien tubule emerges from Grant's abdomen

name: Grant's Distraction and Retreat
description: Grant watches Starla as she sits on the edge of the bed, her back to him. He moves toward her, his shirt lifting slightly at the stomach as a thin, writhing tubule emerges. It extends toward Starla’s back, aiming steadily. Grant’s gaze falls on the nape of her neck, her delicate ear. His expression shifts, his body stilling. The tubule begins to retract. He turns away, pressing it back under his shirt. Starla turns to face him. Grant avoids her eyes. Starla asks, “What are you doing?” Grant looks at her and says, “You’re pretty.” She nods, silent, uncertain.
related_events: Grant experiences emotional confusion upon viewing Starla's neck and ear
Grant attempts to conceal the tubule by pushing it back under his shirt

name: Starla Confronts Grant About His Strange Behavior
description: Starla sees Grant standing near the bed, his back turned to her as he fumbles with his shirt. She notices something odd about his movements and asks, "What are you doing?" Grant turns to her and says, "You're pretty." His voice is soft. Starla looks at him, unsure how to respond, her expression caught between concern and bewilderment.
related_events: Starla discovers Grant acting strangely and confronts him
Grant compliments Starla's appearance amid the tense encounter

name: Butcher Asks About Deer Cheer
description: Grant stands beside the shopping cart near the butcher's counter, looking through the glass at the display of meats. The butcher greets him, saying, 'Howdy, Mr. Grant. You goin' to the Deer Cheer this weekend?' Grant snaps out of his daze and replies, 'Sure thing, killer.'
related_events: Butcher asks Grant about attending the Deer Cheer

name: Grant Orders Steaks at the Butcher Counter
description: Grant stands beside the butcher's counter, looking through the glass at the display of steaks. The butcher greets him and asks if he's going to the Deer Cheer that weekend. Grant says he is. He tells the butcher he's thinking about getting a couple of rib eyes. When asked how many, he hesitates, first saying eight, then revising it to fourteen. The butcher begins to pull the steaks from the case. Grant laughs and tells him to take all the rib eyes. He also asks for chicken wings, pork loins, and points to the osso buco, adding those to his order.
related_events: Grant considers purchasing rib eye steaks at the butcher counter
Grant decides on quantity of steaks for a dinner party

name: Grant Buys Large Order for Dinner Party
description: Grant stands beside the butcher's counter with a shopping cart, looking through the glass at the display of steaks, pork chops, and other meats. The butcher greets him and asks if he’s going to the Deer Cheer that weekend. Grant says he is. When asked what he’d like, he says he’s thinking about a couple of rib eyes, then hesitates and increases the number to eight, then fourteen. He laughs and tells the butcher to give him all the rib eyes they have. The butcher begins gathering them. Grant adds chicken wings, pork loins, and points to the osso buco, asking what it is and adding it to his order.
related_events: Grant impulsively decides to buy all available rib eye steaks
Grant requests additional items for his dinner party

name: Grant Prepares Meat in the Garage
description: Grant tears open packages of meat and lets the loose chunks fall onto the garage floor. He rolls slabs of beef across the dirty surface, gathering them into a pile. A rat darts out, skitters around the pile, and begins nibbling on a piece of meat. Grant peers around the pile, sees the rat, and suddenly lunges, grabbing it. The rat squeaks and thrashes, biting at him as he holds it. Grant snaps its neck, then tosses the dead animal onto the pile of meat before continuing his work.
related_events: Grant empties meat packages onto garage floor
Grant rolls beef slabs into a pile on dirty floor

name: Grant Catches Rat Feeding on Meat
description: Grant stands in the garage, tearing open packages and letting meat spill onto the floor in loose piles. He rolls slabs of beef across the dirty ground, building a larger heap. A rat darts out, skitters around the pile, and begins nibbling on a set of ribs. Grant notices, peers around the meat, and watches the animal for a moment. Suddenly, he lunges forward, grabbing the rat with sharp speed. The rat squeaks, writhing and biting as it struggles to break free. Grant snaps its neck, then tosses the lifeless body onto the pile of meat. He continues his work without pause.
related_events: Rat emerges and nibbles on meat ribs
Grant realizes the rat is meat
Grant captures struggling rat with sudden speed
Rat bites and wriggles to escape Grant's grip

name: Kill Rat and Add to Meat Pile
description: Grant snaps the rat's neck, then tosses the dead animal onto the pile of meat. He resumes rolling slabs of beef across the dirty floor, continuing his work without pause.
related_events: Grant snaps rat's neck and adds it to meat pile
Grant continues processing meat after killing rat

name: Cops Remove Gear After Shift
description: The four police officers start taking off their holsters and duty gear, setting their equipment aside as the workday ends. They relax into a more casual mood, shifting from the routine of duty to easy conversation.
related_events: Cops begin removing their holsters after finishing shift

name: Trevor Shares a Fear and Is Laughed At
description: Trevor says he gets afraid when the cops remove their holsters because he once heard the ground could crack open and swallow someone, burning them up instantly like his uncle Barry. Wally and Bill laugh at his story. Wally asks who told him that, and Trevor says his aunt. Bill adds that Uncle Barry left her for a stripper in Winnsboro, leaving Trevor looking shocked and sad.
related_events: Trevor expresses fear about ground cracking open
Wally and Bill laugh at Trevor's story

name: Bill Reveals the Truth About Uncle Barry
description: Wally asks Trevor who told him the story about his uncle Barry falling into a crack in the ground because of the heat. Bill interrupts, saying Barry didn’t die—he left Trevor’s aunt for a stripper in Winnsboro. Trevor stares, stunned and upset, as the others react around him.
related_events: Wally questions origin of Trevor's story
Bill reveals truth about Uncle Barry leaving for a stripper
Trevor reacts with shock and sadness to revelation

name: Shelby Interrupts with Diner Emergency
description: The four cops begin removing their holsters and gear, winding down for the day. Trevor expresses fear about the ground cracking open and swallowing someone, saying it happened to his uncle Barry. Wally and Bill laugh. Wally asks who told him that story, and Trevor says his aunt. Bill adds that Uncle Barry left her for a stripper in Winnsboro, leaving Trevor shocked and sad. Shelby, the dispatcher, swivels around in his chair, alarmed, and calls out to the chief: there's an emergency at the diner.
related_events: Shelby alerts chief about emergency at diner

name: Grant Approaches the Giggling Children
description: Grant creeps toward a group of children who are giggling, unaware of his presence. He moves closer, his excitement evident, when he hears a voice call out. He turns to see Brenda Gutierrez standing nearby, clearly drunk. She smiles at him and says, 'Hey there, handsome.' Grant returns her smile and asks, 'Where's the old half-Mexican?' Brenda replies, 'Took the kids to his Mom's for the weekend.' Grant grins as he looks around to see if anyone is watching, then begins to circle her.
related_events: Grant approaches children while they giggle

name: Grant Reacts to Brenda's Sudden Appearance
description: Grant turns toward the sound of Brenda's voice, startled, and sees her standing there. She is drunk once again. He smiles and remarks that it might be fate they’ve met like this. Glancing around to see if anyone is watching, he moves around her, commenting that she looks pretty. She tells him to shut up and snickers. He asks where her husband is, and she replies that he’s taken the kids to his mother’s for the weekend. Grant smiles.
related_events: Brenda Gutierrez greets Grant from off-screen
Grant turns and sees Brenda Gutierrez
Grant considers possibility of fate with Brenda

name: Grant Approaches Brenda
description: The children giggle, unaware of Grant moving closer. He stops when he hears Brenda's voice. She stands there, clearly drunk, and says, 'Hey there, handsome.' Grant turns and sees her. 'Must be fate, us meeting again like this,' she says. He smiles and replies, 'Well, you might be right...' He glances around to see if anyone is watching. Then he walks around her. 'You're lookin' awful pretty,' he says. 'Shut up,' Brenda replies, snickering. 'Where's the old half-Mexican?' Grant asks. 'Took the kids to his Mom's for the weekend,' she answers. Grant smiles.
related_events: Grant checks for onlookers before circling Brenda
Grant compliments Brenda on her appearance
Brenda snickers after telling Grant to shut up

name: Grant Asks About Brenda's Partner and Smiles When Learning the Kids Are Away
description: Grant looks around to see if anyone is watching, then circles behind Brenda. He asks where her partner is. Brenda tells him the kids are with their father at his mother's for the weekend. Grant smiles.
related_events: Grant asks about Brenda's partner
Brenda reveals partner took children to his mother's
Grant smiles upon learning children are away

name: Starla and Grant at the Country-Western Party
description: A country-western band plays music at a lively social gathering. Couples dance the two-step on the floor, swaying and stepping in rhythm. Starla and Grant move through the crowd, passing laughing guests and spinning dancers. Starla spots her friend Janene and calls out to her. Janene laughs and the two embrace. Grant nods toward the men’s group nearby. 'I'll go see what the boys are doing,' he says. Starla watches him walk away as she begins talking with Janene.
related_events: Country-western band performs at the party
Couples dance the two-step on the dance floor
Starla and Grant navigate through the party crowd

name: Starla Reunites with Janene at the Party
description: Starla sees her friend Janene in the crowd and calls out to her. Janene laughs and the two embrace warmly. Grant greets Janene, then steps away to give the friends space, moving off through the dancing couples and laughter toward the group of men nearby.
related_events: Starla recognizes her school friend Janene
Starla and Janene greet and embrace each other
Grant acknowledges Janene and offers Starla time to catch up

name: Starla Confides in Janene About Grant
description: After Grant walks off to find his friends, Starla turns to Janene and says he’s been acting strangely the past couple of days. The two stand together amid the music and laughter, the dance floor swirling around them as Starla speaks.
related_events: Starla expresses concern about Grant's recent behavior
Grant leaves to find his friends in the crowd

name: Grant enters the garage and examines the file cabinet
description: Grant comes in from the foyer and flips on the lights with his shoulder. He looks around the garage and notices an old file cabinet. He walks over and opens one drawer, which is filled with files. He closes it and opens another, finding only empty manila folders inside. He takes the folders out and sets them aside.
related_events: Grant enters garage from foyer and turns on lights
Grant discovers empty file cabinet drawer

The trail leads him to a patch of colorful wildflowers where something rustles faintly. He moves closer and sees a gelatinous yellow organism moving between the flowers. It is veiny and mound-shaped, with a pulsing cavity at the top. Grant picks up a branch and prods it. The organism shifts slightly. He pokes it again. It pulses and surges toward him. He prods it once more. A thin spore emerges from the cavity, quivering, with small bulbed spurs forming along its length. Grant bends down to look. The spore suddenly shoots forward and strikes him in the stomach. He cries out, pulls up his shirt, and sees the spore writhing before vanishing into his skin. He clutches his abdomen, screams, and collapses into the flowers, his body convulsing.
